name: Hack Squat Calf Raise
cues: Put your back to the pad and your forefoot on the low edge of the platform
Keep your legs locked almost straight with the safeties set
Let your heels drop toward the floor for a long stretch
Push up through your big toes until your ankles are fully extended

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Mechanics are right: knee held at 4, ankle 22 to -32 (54 deg ROM), toes extend to 38 over the plate edge, and the sled rides 72 mm. The hero (az -95/0.12) is a side view where the long reclined frame makes the figure about a third of the tile, so the calves (the only primary) are small. Forefoot rests 42 mm into the plate (precedent).
